title: Stoliner Rebbe on Smartphones
body: The Stoliner Rebbe spoke at a tish in Givat Ze'ev, addressing the use of smartphones and modern technology in the chareidi world, presenting an approach that balances reality with uncompromising values.

title: Rav Dovid Cohen Rejects Draft Law
body: Rav Dovid Cohen, Chevron Yeshiva rosh yeshiva, rejects Israel's Bismuth draft law, saying "there is nothing to discuss – whoever is not learning does not enlist."
